author: HSinghHira
description:
Pocket ID is a simple, OpenID Connect Certified OIDC and OAuth 2.0 provider built entirely around passkeys - no passwords, no accounts to leak, just sign in with a passkey or a hardware key like a YubiKey.

**Features**

- Passkey-only authentication - no passwords exist anywhere in the
  system.

- OpenID Connect Certified and OAuth 2.0 compliant, so it works with
  most apps that support "Login with OIDC".

- Simple admin UI for managing users, groups, and OIDC clients,
  without the complexity of Keycloak or ORY Hydra.

- Optional self-service user signups, LDAP sync, and SCIM
  provisioning for pulling in users from an existing directory.

- SQLite by default, with no separate database container needed.
  Persistent storage under /DATA/AppData/pocket-id.


**How to use?**
1. Open Pocket ID from the Zima OS dashboard.
2. Go to /setup and create the first administrator account with a
   passkey.

3. Add your other users, or connect LDAP if you already have a
   directory.

4. Create an OIDC client for each self-hosted app you want to add
   single sign-on to.

5. Point that app's OIDC settings at your Pocket ID issuer URL, and
   copy over the client ID and secret.

6. Further settings, like custom branding, email, and self-service
   signups, live in the in-app admin panel under Settings, or can be
   locked to the environment variables below by setting
   UI_CONFIG_DISABLED to true.
tagline: A simple, passkey-only OIDC and OAuth 2.0 provider for your self-hosted apps.

tips.before_install:
1. Open the app configuration before starting the installation.

2. Find APP_URL in the pocket-id service. It says
   CHANGEME_YOUR_SERVER_URL.

3. Set it to the exact address you will open Pocket ID at, like
   https://your-server-ip:8436. Must be a secure IP/URL.

4. Do not change APP_URL later. Passkeys are locked to this exact
   address, and changing it can break sign in.

5. Find ENCRYPTION_KEY. It is pre-filled with a random value.

6. Replace it with your own. Generate one at randomkeygen.com.

7. Only change ENCRYPTION_KEY right after this fresh install,
   before adding real users.

8. Want open or invite-only signups instead of admin-only? Set
   ALLOW_USER_SIGNUPS to open or withToken, and make sure
   UI_CONFIG_DISABLED stays set to true.

9. Start the Pocket ID installation.

10. Open Pocket ID from the Zima OS dashboard.

11. Go to the /setup page and create your admin account with a
    passkey.

12. More settings, like LDAP sync and email, are in the in-app
    admin panel under Settings.

title: Pocket ID
release_note:
- Added the missing top-level `name` field so Pocket ID's data now
  stores under /DATA/AppData/pocket-id instead of an
  auto-generated compose-<hash> folder.

- Added UI_CONFIG_DISABLED, ALLOW_USER_SIGNUPS, ANALYTICS_DISABLED,
  and VERSION_CHECK_DISABLED environment variables.

- Switched APP_URL's placeholder to the standard CHANGEME_* format.

- Added the per-service x-casaos envs/ports/volumes metadata.
